root_cause.text: The pm_restore_gfp_mask() function has a WARN_ON() that fires when saved_gfp_count is 0, but hibernation paths (e.g., uswsusp) call it defensively even when no prior restriction was done, causing a false positive warning.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states that "some hibernation paths call pm_restore_gfp_mask() defensively where the GFP mask may or may not be restricted" and that "Before the stacking change this was a silent no-op; it now triggers a spurious WARNING." The patch removes the WARN_ON() wrapper from the `!saved_gfp_count` check, keeping the silent no-op behavior.
